graph_degree.held_source_auprc: eligible development-only after complete held-source and held-block removal

graph_source_count.held_source_auprc: eligible development-only after complete held-source and held-block removal

regularized_linear_evidence.held_source_auprc: eligible development-only after nested cross-source and LD/gene-block fitting
regularized_linear_evidence.brier_score: eligible for the native frozen development-mixture sigmoid probability; no held-source prevalence recalibration

current_coloc_gwas.biological_unit: study; expected n=50 source studies after corrected promotion
current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Only after the corrected 50-study COLOC release and immutable graph snapshot, native-build LD blocks, loci, source families, statuses, observability, and candidate universe are promoted.
restrictions: Current memberships, examples, and Gene Catalog content are exposed and provisional.
Compute ancestry-aware LD on each native build before liftover.
A study, cohort release, accession alias, and derivative table from one underlying source form one source_family_id.
COLOC alone supports colocalized or genetically anchored candidate language, not causal gene.

gse281364.biological_unit: experimental replicate; n=16 across HepG2 control/PAOA and LX-2 control/TGF-beta contexts
gse281364.topology: MPRA DNA and RNA counts are same-sample different aliquots
gse281364.allowed_use: Reporter evidence may define an assay-native activity or allelic-direction source after locus-cross-fitted aggregation and threshold/status rules are frozen without the evaluated rows.
restrictions: Four replicates per context do not become four evidence source families.
Technical rows, barcodes, alleles, and constructs do not become independent source support.
MPRA activity alone is not an endogenous enhancer-gene link or causal-gene label.
Missing oligo, allele, context, DNA, or RNA joins are explicit missing states, not negative activity.

gse281160.topology: guide and RNA are same cell; six sequencing lanes are technical
gse281160.allowed_use: A functional source only after target-locus, guide-family, experimental-replicate, response-gene, status, and evidence-unit rules are frozen and all scoring aggregates to biological replicates.
restrictions: The 20 targets were selected from MPRA and are not an unbiased graph seal.
Cells, guides, target loci, sequencing lanes, and genes are not independent source families or biological replicates.
A perturbation response can support only the exact locus-gene or program relation registered by the evidence ontology; it cannot be expanded by nearest-gene assignment.

gse289173.allowed_use: none for this typed-evidence graph task
gse289173.reason: Its cell-state and QTL outcomes belong to the separately held-back cell and variant evaluator. They cannot define graph edges, labels, features, calibration, thresholds, or source observability.

resource_gene_catalog_current.allowed_use: Only as exposed development content after immutable graph promotion.
resource_gene_catalog_current.restriction: Existing Resource evidence classes, claims, Gene Catalog, and frozen 117 programs cannot be changed, relabeled, optimized, or used as a pseudo-seal based on model output.

held_source_protocol.candidate_universe: Freeze source-independent native-build variants, ancestry-aware LD blocks, loci, and genes before seeing held-source eligibility. Held-source-only candidates remain evaluator-only.
held_source_protocol.complete_removal: Delete held-source aliases, nodes, edges, inverse edges, provenance, coverage, observability, tested status, missingness, deterministic derivatives, aggregates, paths, degrees, source counts, candidate-universe contributions, and normalization before any baseline feature is calculated.
held_source_protocol.held_block: Remove every edge incident to an outer-held locus before graph construction, feature aggregation, cross-source training examples, and calibration. Merge loci within 1 Mb or r2 >= 0.8 in any represented ancestry, then preserve gene blocks.
held_source_protocol.training_labels: Regularized linear evidence learns from pseudo-held development sources. For each pseudo-source, support is positive and explicit tested-negative eligibility is negative; all other statuses are excluded from the binary loss and retained in masks.
held_source_protocol.success_interpretation: Remaining-source study intensity or typed evidence predicts support in an already exposed removed source. This is cross-source prioritization, not causal recovery.

graph_degree.question: Does a gene rank well merely because it has many remaining evidence-bearing graph connections?
graph_degree.bias_audit: Report total, in-, and out-degree distributions; AUPRC within remaining-source observability and degree strata; and correlation with evidence_count and graph_source_count.
graph_degree.unit_warning: Edges and genes do not supply independent inference. Bootstrap native LD and gene blocks.

graph_source_count.question: Does breadth across distinct remaining source families explain apparent recovery?
graph_source_count.bias_audit: Report per-source contribution, alias collapse, source concentration, and performance within remaining-source observability strata.
graph_source_count.unit_warning: Experimental replicates, technical releases, accessions, and papers from one source do not create extra source families.

regularized_linear_evidence.question: Can a transparent cross-source weighted combination of typed evidence match graph neural models?
regularized_linear_evidence.bias_audit: Report coefficients with raw source and assay units, feature missingness, source-held performance, calibration by source and observability, and leave-one-feature-family-out sensitivity.
regularized_linear_evidence.unit_warning: Candidate rows share locus, gene, and source dependence. Fit and uncertainty use grouped source, LD, and gene blocks rather than row-level independence.

assay_native_missingness_and_observabili.raw_units: Keep colocalization statistics, MPRA activity/effect, CROP-seq response, distance, and counts in separately identified columns with source, metric, unit, direction, and provenance. A linear model may training-standardize a column but cannot pool incompatible units first.
assay_native_missingness_and_observabili.zero: Degree or count zero means an observed applicable remaining graph with no qualifying edge or source. If no remaining source is applicable or observable, emit structurally_missing.
assay_native_missingness_and_observabili.linear_model: A masked numeric channel plus full state indicators preserves the difference between measured zero, absence of support, tested negative, assay untestability, and unavailable data.

calibration_and_uncertainty.graph_degree: Native score is an integer count, not a probability. Brier is blocked until a source-blind cross-fitted one-dimensional calibrator is separately frozen.
calibration_and_uncertainty.graph_source_count: Native score is an integer count, not a probability. Brier is blocked until a source-blind cross-fitted one-dimensional calibrator is separately frozen.
calibration_and_uncertainty.regularized_linear_evidence: The native sigmoid is calibrated only to its frozen equal-source and equal-block development training mixture. Report calibration by source and observability; never adapt to held-source prevalence.
calibration_and_uncertainty.bootstrap: Use 10000 paired two-way native-build LD-block and gene-block bootstrap replicates. Candidate genes, variants, graph edges, evidence rows, and source records stay nested.
calibration_and_uncertainty.seeds: Deterministic graph aggregation has no seed. Linear solver or fold-tie randomness uses the RunSpec seed; seeds measure stability and are not independent biological evidence.

claim_and_selection_boundary.selection: Every graph model must beat graph_degree, graph_source_count, nearest_gene, evidence_count, and regularized_linear_evidence where their registered outputs are applicable. Transparent baseline success is an accepted result.
claim_and_selection_boundary.multiplicity: BH q<0.05 within the secondary typed-evidence-graph source and endpoint family.
claim_and_selection_boundary.champion: No wholly sealed evidence source exists. No graph champion can be declared, regardless of development AUPRC.
claim_and_selection_boundary.causality: Scores prioritize genetically anchored candidates. They do not establish causal genes, pathways, disease mechanisms, diagnosis, prognosis, or treatment response.

reproducibility_contract.graph_receipt: Hash the promoted graph snapshot, source taxonomy, ontology, native coordinates, LD and gene blocks, candidate universe, canonical edges, statuses, observability, held-source removal, held-block removal, deduplication, feature rows, and labels.
reproducibility_contract.baseline_receipt: Hash each algorithm ID, edge direction and type roster, source-family map, exact feature lexicon, assay-unit manifest, masks, training transformations, grouped folds, weights, regularization, coefficients, calibration decision, ties, row order, and predictions.
reproducibility_contract.unit_of_inference: independent native-build LD locus with gene-block dependence retained in uncertainty
